question: Can a Pro customer enable SAML SSO? If not, what plan is required?

answer: No, Pro customers cannot enable SAML SSO. SSO (including both SAML 2.0 and OIDC) is available on **Enterprise plans only**. Enterprise plans also include SCIM provisioning and Just-in-time (JIT) provisioning.

# Single Sign-On (SSO)
Owner: Platform

SSO (SAML 2.0 and OIDC) is available on Enterprise only.
Supported IdPs: Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, OneLogin.
SCIM provisioning is included with SSO.
Just-in-time (JIT) provisioning creates users on first login when SCIM is off.
